[[Zhu Hanuku]], or '''"Old Long-arms"''', is a powerful century-old [[Kraken]] and sea spirit that rises every year after being killed. It has become a part of the [[Convocation]] to slay Zhu Hanuku. The [[Kappa]] of [[the Jade Sea]] are said to be its servants.

== Notes ==
* As a [[primary]] [[Mesmer]], its [[Fast Casting]] shortens the casting time of its spells; however, all of its spells have long activation times even with its high rank in Fast Casting and are easy to [[interrupt]].
* The [[Spear of Archemorus]] deals considerably more damage to Zhu Hanuku than stated in the effect description, ranging from 450 damage at level 1 to 1,900 damage at level 5.
* As with all bosses with powerful [[AoE]] attacks, [[Pain Inverter]] is effective against it.

== Trivia ==
{{gw2w}}
* There is a [[miniature]] [[miniature Zhu Hanuku|Zhu Hanuku]].
* Zhu Hanuku looks like a massive [[Phantom_(NPC)|Phantom]] that has an octopus beak, a solid jade shell, and is opaque.
* This is one of the few NPCs in Factions that has a skill ([[Light of Dwayna]]) from [[Prophecies]] or [[Nightfall]].
